source_text.Q-1011: LOW (INV-10 family), S3, GH #2311, local ISS-1029; test-only rework after TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR step-05b FAIL (T5 did not kill a request-decides mutant).

result.summary: Tests only; git diff HEAD -- lib is empty. T5 rewritten into two tests. (1) 'a request naming the STORED source or target id never opens a non-party review': review (b, p) in A's schema read as TENANT_ADMIN of A; for each named id in [b, p, a] and each channel (query keys tenant_id/source_tenant_id/target_tenant_id/tenant/tenantId; x-tenant-id and x-letflow-tenant headers; a body_params body with the same keys; all together) on /:id and /:id/context the response is 404 and equals the nonexistent-id baseline sent with the SAME query/headers/body; the list under every channel and named id returns items []. (2) 'a request naming a foreign tenant never closes or opens a party review': parties (a, b) and (b, a), channels naming b and p, on /:id and /:id/context observable-equal to the plain read; list still shows both rows. get_resp/6 and baseline/6 gained an optional body argument (Fixture.router_conn already supports it). A GET carries no path-borne tenant, so there is no path channel. MUTANTS RE-APPLIED (repro file, --exclude long_hidden_run, each alone, lib restored by git checkout after each; git diff HEAD -- lib empty at the end): N3q (the validator's form: authenticated tenant_id replaced by the tenant_id query param when binary) 34/36 passed, 2 failed (both T5 tests); N3h (replaced by the x-tenant-id header) 34/36, 2 failed (both T5 tests); N3body (replaced by body_params["tenant_id"], a first attempt that crashed on the Unfetched body struct was corrected) 34/36, 2 failed (both T5 tests); N3 (compared id replaced by the tenant_id param, the original form) 34/36, 2 failed (both T5 tests). Clean lib: repro file 38/38 (long_hidden_run tests included), 36/36 with them excluded; mix format --check-formatted exit 0. test/specs/ISS-1029.md: AC3 row and the N3 mutant rows (N3, N3q, N3h, N3body) updated to the measured attribution. VALIDATOR MINOR (AC4, list has no 404; cursor page compares only that next_cursor is binary): informational, accepted by the validator, no test change. NOT RUN: files other than the repro file (only it and the spec changed; lib untouched); mix letflow.lint_handoffs result is quoted in the reply.
